As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstart ers the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

We are not a siloed engineering team-we collaborate deeply with cross-functional stakeholders and play a central role in shaping the future of Upstart ’s marketing platforms.

Art of Problem Solving is looking for Math Instructors to join their Virtual Campus team.
This is a part-time position. Many of our weekday classes start as early as 4pm ET and as late as 10pm ET. Classes are also offered all day on Sundays from 10am ET- 9pm ET. This might be a good fit if you:

• Are a rock-star teacher with a passion for working with high-achieving students

• Are an engaging, enthusiastic instructor who can motivate gifted learners

• Have strong math content knowledge

• Aren’t afraid of student-led instruction, discussions, and allowing students to do the heavy lifting

• Foster a classroom environment that encourages critical thinking and problem solving

• Are comfortable teaching in a live virtual classroom environment

• Have an interest in teaching elementary, middle school and high school levels

For each lesson you will:

• Teach enthusiastic elementary, middle, and high school students in our online classrooms.

• Use our curriculum to teach participation-oriented classes that focus on instruction and developing skills, not on rote memorization.

• Work in small classes (average size 12) with top performing students who are passionate about learning and are motivated to succeed.

Requirements:

• Must have a solid academic background in mathematics.

•
A bachelor's degree in a STEM field is required. A master's degree or higher in a STEM field is preferred.

• Must have some experience using Zoom or similar video conferencing software and be comfortable managing a classroom in a virtual setting.

• Must have some experience teaching or tutoring students at the K-12 level. Some experience working with advanced students is preferred.

• All functions of this role must be completed in the U.S.

The instructor rate at the Virtual Campus is $30/hour for Year-Round classes. The class rates represent flexible work time, 15 minutes early arrival immediately before class, and actual class time.

• Paid Sick Leave *

• 401K retirement plan

• Employee discount on classes and Beast Academy Online (BAO) yearly subscriptions

*Not applicable to all states

AoPS is on a mission to discover, inspire, and train the great problem solvers of the next generation. Just like our traditional AoPS Academy experience, our range of math course offerings at the AoPS Academy Virtual Campus allows students the opportunity to explore new interests while strengthening their math and problem-solving skills.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive, London
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Open to hiring remote in London, UK.

 

You will carry a book of 40-60 mid-market and emerging accounts - companies in the <$1B range, closing 25-40 deals a year at $40k-$100k and building toward larger standard deal sizes as our packaging moves upmarket. You work in a pod with a dedicated Mid-Market Engagement Manager on a shared book, with a comp plan designed to maximize earnings and customer value.

 

We are architecting the best GTM team in all of AI. If you want to grow, run fast, and sell with a leading-edge frontier AI company with room to grow your career, please apply.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run a high-velocity full-cycle motion: 25-40 closed deals a year across inbound and outbound

- Qualify hard and fast - your book is big, your calendar is the scarce resource, orientation to clear ROI and value orientation is a must

- Push deal size up: committed-volume, use-case expansion plays that turn $30k starts into $100k+ repeatable motions

- Turn product signals (usage spikes, team signups, credit burn) into pipeline

- Work with your pod's Engagement Manager so new customers hit consumption targets and your held-back commission unlocks

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 3+ years of full-cycle closing experience in SaaS/AI with a quota record above 100%

- Velocity evidence: 20+ closed deals a year, multi-channel prospecting, disciplined qualification

- Native AI-tool fluency - you already sell with AI in your workflow, not despite it

- Writing and demo skills strong enough to carry a deal without a solutions engineer

- Coachability with a track record: name the coaching that changed your numbers

 

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

- Sold to creative or marketing teams

- PLG or usage-signal selling experience

- BDR-to-AE promotion in your history - we like people who earned the chair

 

COMPENSATION

OTE $270K - $300K (50/50 base to variable). Offers equity.

title: Sales Development Representative (copy)
description:
Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses, and our growth depends on a steady flow of qualified sales opportunities. We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to be the tip of that spear: the first person prospective customers meet and the engine that keeps our pipeline full.

This is a high-energy, high-ownership seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn the craft fast and grow into bigger things. You'll identify companies that are actively hiring for roles Wing can support, reach out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

It's a great fit for someone who's competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams.

What You'll Do

Generate and Qualify Pipeline

• Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can service, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles.

• Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit.

• Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels.

• Run focused outbound campaigns around hiring signals, job postings, company growth, and operational pain points.

• Hold early discovery conversations to understand the prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions.

• Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting.

• Book qualified appointments for Account Executives with companies that have a clear need, relevant hiring activity, or a strong use case for Wing.

Partner with the Sales Team

• Work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline.

• Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context AEs need to move deals forward.

• Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved.

• Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM.

Bring the Market Back In

• Feed what you're hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.

• Help refine messaging and outreach based on what's actually landing with companies.

• Identify patterns in hiring demand, objections, and industries where Wing is resonating.

• Suggest new outbound angles based on job postings, hiring trends, and prospect conversations.

What We're Looking For

Core Requirements

• 1-4+ years in sales, business development, appointment setting, cold calling, recruiting, staffing, or a comparable outbound role.

• A real interest in B2B sales; bonus points if it's in SaaS, AI, staffing, recruiting, outsourcing, or global workforce operations.

• Proven background in sales prospecting, cold calling, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound outreach.

• Strong written and verbal communication; you can get to the point and make it compelling.

• Comfort reaching out to companies that may not have considered remote assistants, virtual assistants, or offshore talent before.

• Strong research skills and the ability to turn hiring signals into relevant outbound messaging.

• Strong organization and the resilience to keep going when a day doesn't go your way.

• The drive that comes from chasing clear goals, activity metrics, and booked meeting targets.

• The ability to run your own desk while still collaborating well across teams.

• A genuine eagerness to learn the product, the industry, and the sales craft quickly.

Nice to Have

• Exposure to staffing companies, recruiting firms, BPOs, outsourcing companie

Global Regulatory Compliance

● Issue Resolution: Lead root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and Out of Specification (OOS) investigations. Make critical disposition decisions regarding product approvals, quarantines, or rejections. 

● Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, scale, and maintain internal QMS documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), finished product specifications, and quality agreements with external partners.

At Engine , we’re transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented - we’re here to change that. To make this vision real, we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine -only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

About the Role
The Director of Strategy & Operations, Partnerships is the day-to-day thought partner to the Chief Business Officer and his leadership team, and owns how the partnerships organization plans and executes.
The scope centers on Partnerships (Business Development and Partner Success), plus the supply and enterprise sales cycles that touch the partner motion.
Your mandate is to uplevel how it runs. You will influence strategic direction and help drive execution, while finding and unblocking the productivity bottlenecks that slow the team down. AI is central. You will decide where AI belongs in the partnerships motion and hold the team accountable to real productivity gains.
This is a hands-on role. You will get into the data yourself and build the analysis leadership acts on. You will hire and lead a team of two to four analysts and operations partners over the next 12 to 18 months.
Strategy & Operations sits inside Revenue Operations alongside GTM Systems, Revenue Enablement, and GTM Finance. You will also partner closely with Growth, Central Data, and Corporate Finance.
What You'll Do
Strategy and Planning

• Own segmentation, partner tiering, and book of business design across BD and Partner Success.

• Partner with GTM Finance on the capacity model, quotas, and headcount plan.

• Define the metrics and instrumentation for the business, including in-year GBV, partner-sourced pipeline, and Engine X attach.

• Build and run the partnerships operating cadence: annual planning, tier calibration, weekly and monthly pipeline reviews, and QBRs with strategic partners.

Partnerships Motion

• Standardize the motion: partner types, handoffs, stages, exit criteria, and rules of engagement.

• Partner with Revenue Enablement to translate strategy into training, playbooks, and tools the field will use.

• Partner with GTM Finance on comp design and visibility.

• Own partner economics with GTM Finance: rev-share models, contract structures, and deal desk.

AI, Systems, and Insights

• Set the AI strategy for the partnerships motion and lead the rollout across partner scoring, pipeline forecasting, deal desk, and rep-facing insights.

• Partner with GTM Systems on the tools, AI, and insights the field runs on.

• Test hypotheses on segmentation, coverage, and productivity, and translate them into decisions.

What You'll Bring

• 10+ years in strategy & operations or revenue operations, with substantial time inside a partnerships or channel organization at a high-growth B2B SaaS, fintech, or marketplace business.

• A track record as the primary strategic and operational partner to a VP or C-level revenue leader.

• A clear point of view on where AI and automation belong in a modern partnerships motion, and evidence of shipping it at scale.

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Through its subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes $22 billion monthly for its customers while operating profitably.
About the role
We’re looking for a Copywriter to join our Creative team.This role is for you if you’re a strong writer, a curious thinker, and a customer-focused creative who knows how to turn ideas and insights into clear, engaging copy that people understand and act on.
You’ll work across Marketing, Product, Growth, CRM, Social, and Design to create communications for Moniepoint ’s products and customers, from campaigns and product launches to CRM, social media content, performance ads, and everything in between, to develop messaging that supports acquisition, engagement, retention, and customer loyalty.
This is a hands-on role for someone who can adapt their writing across different channels and audiences while maintaining a consistent Moniepoint voice. You should understand consumer behaviour, enjoy solving communication problems, and know how to make complex information simple and relatable.
Responsibilities:

• Write clear, engaging, human-centred copy across Moniepoint ’s products and marketing channels, including the app, website, CRM, social media, product experiences, and performance marketing.

• Develop creative concepts and copy for campaigns across OOH, digital, social, TV, radio, CRM, performance, and other channels.

• Work with Product, Growth, Design, Motion, Animation, Marketing, CRM, and Social teams to develop and execute campaigns.

• Translate complex financial products, features, and services into simple, relatable messaging that customers can understand and trust.

• Write performance marketing copy for platforms including Google, Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

• Maintain a consistent Moniepoint tone of voice across different communications and touchpoints.

• Create culturally relevant content that reflects our customers' realities, behaviours, and everyday experiences.

• Work closely with designers and other creatives to ensure copy and visual execution work together.

• Support product launches, seasonal campaigns, partnerships, and customer education initiatives.

Requirements:

• 3+ years of professional copywriting experience, preferably in an agency, brand, fintech, technology, media, or consumer-facing environment.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating good writing, creative thinking, and experience across different channels.

• Experience developing copy for campaigns, product launches, social media, CRM, performance marketing, and digital platforms.

• Experience writing scripts for motion graphics and animated videos

• Experience writing performance marketing copy for platforms such as Google, Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

• Familiarity with content best practices is an advantage.

About you:

•
Creative thinker: You can take a brief and find an interesting, relevant way to communicate the message.

•
Customer obsessed : You think about who you're speaking to and what matters to them before you start writing.

•
Clear communicator: You know how to make complex ideas simple without losing what makes them important.

•
Commercially aware : You understand that good copy should serve a purpose, whether that's building awareness, driving action, educating customers, or improving engagement.

•
Insights driven: You’re interested in customer behaviour and use research, feedback, and performance data to make your work better.

•
Collaborative : You work well with designers, marketers, strategists, product teams, and other creatives and are open to feedback.

•
Detail oriented: You care about the words you put out into the world and take pride in getting the details right.

•
Adaptable

title: Senior Security Engineer - Platform Trust & Safety
description:
About Datadog

We're on a mission to build the best platform in the world for engineers to understand and scale their systems, applications, and teams. We operate at a high scale - trillions of data points per day - providing always-on alerting, metrics visualization, logs, and application tracing for tens of thousands of companies. Our engineering culture values pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity to solve hard problems the right way.

 

The Opportunity

User safety and platform integrity is critical to our business. Our customer’s success is our success. We’re looking for a Senior Security Engineer to join us in taking a proactive, highly scalable, and data-centric approach to enabling a safe and trustworthy experience for the users of our rapidly growing and increasingly interactive platform. You’ll fight against threats to our users, platform abuse, and other potentially risky and unwanted behaviors on our platform.  

 

Our team covers a broad range of trust and safety related topics including software engineering, data science, user engagement, privacy, threat detection, incident response, and bridging gaps between security and the broader Datadog business. You will bring expertise in a few of these areas.

 

You’ll join a growing security team at an ideal time for making a big impact. Datadog is growing rapidly, and AI-assisted development is increasing both the pace of software delivery and the amount of activity generated by AI agents. The product is seeing very high growth, with the platform becoming more interactive and new products and features developed regularly.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Have a direct impact on customers and their overall trust of our platform.

• Drive the technical roadmap in collaboration with your team, product management, and other engineering teams to align our work with company-wide security objectives.

• Mentor a team of 3+ software and security engineers, emphasizing engineering quality, resiliency, and delivery.

• Develop user-friendly UI components that enable users to strengthen the security of their account.

• Create metrics and measurements to better understand how users are interacting with our security-related features and controls.

• Have an opportunity to work across the stack, implementing both front-end and back-end code.

• Develop risk scoring algorithms to classify potentially risky behavior or activity on our platform.

• Work in a highly collaborative role, often engaging with engineering teams beyond security.

• Contribute to security operations efforts including threat detection and response.

• Participate in Datadog’s incident response efforts.

 

Who You Are: 

• Have 5+ years of software security engineering experience, especially on teams building platform and user security features.

• An excellent communicator and collaborator, able to work effectively through complex technical problems with a diverse group of stakeholders.

• Prior experience working with product and design teams to deliver front-end features.

• Fluent in one or more modern coding languages (Python, Go, TypeScript, etc.).

• Comfortable working in a fast paced, high growth environment.

• Knowledgeable of abuse techniques in modern SaaS applications.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth: 

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for i

title: Sales Engineer
description:
About Venn

Venn is revolutionizing how businesses enable BYOD workforces, removing the burden of buying and securing laptops or dealing with virtual desktops. Our patented technology provides companies with a new approach to securing remote employees and contractors working on unmanaged computers. With Venn ’s Blue Border™ software, work lives in a company-controlled Secure Enclave installed on the user’s computer, enabling IT teams to secure company data while ensuring end-user privacy. Over 700 organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, and Voya, trust Venn to meet FINRA, SEC, NAIC, and SOC 2 standards.

The Opportunity

The Sales Engineer will join our company at a time of growth and change. They will be at the forefront of Venn 's business expansion, working to grow revenue. Sales Engineers apply their technical knowledge to the sales cycle, demonstrating our product, articulating its features and value proposition, and addressing technical questions or concerns.

What You'll Do

• Support the pre-sales cycle by leading product demonstrations to prospective customers

• Provide technical support on sales calls and at presentations throughout the sales cycle, articulating the features, benefits, key differentiators, and value proposition of our product

• Develop collateral to drive adoption and support product training

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of our product, the market, and other competitive solutions

• Use technical savvy and product expertise to drive brand awareness and support our Sales and Marketing strategies at webinars, conferences, and other industry events

• Work with the Product and Sales teams to ensure correct pricing

• Document activities, customer, and partner learnings within the company's CRM software

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in a pre-sales technical role, ideally supporting sales of secure workspace or similar technology solutions

• Deep technical knowledge of end user computing models, Windows architecture and applications, virtual desktop infrastructure

• 2+ years of experience with VDI and adjacent technologies (i.e. secure browsing), as well as networking (e.g. VPNs)

• 2+ years of experience with Microsoft 365 Suite (including any AAD/Entra ID), Google Workspace, Okta, and other cloud-based services

• Experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies and understanding of overall landscape of network-based vs agent-based solutions

• Expertise in endpoint security, general information and data security, data loss prevention and data governance

• Understands industry-specific compliance requirements (PCI, HIPAA, SEC, CMMC, FINRA, SOC, etc.) and how they impact customer requirements

• B.S. or B.A. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field strongly preferred

• Experience working within a growth-stage company preferred

• Technical, solutions-oriented, and customer-focused with exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Up-to-date knowledge of new technologies, industry trends, and the B2B market

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

• Competitive compensation and commission opportunities

• Equity at Venn

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance

• Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits

• Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off

• The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment and we look for teammates who do the same!

title: Director, Data Architecture (AI Enablement)
description:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney- we are on a mission to transform finance- and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

AI is only as useful as the data it can safely reach. As Director, Data Architecture, you will own how our organization’s information, from databases to data warehouses to email, documents, Notion, Confluence, and Slack, becomes discoverable, trustworthy, and securely available to AI assistants, agents, and search tools.

This is a senior technical leadership role with enterprise-wide architectural accountability.  You will own the direction, make the platform and standards decisions, and partner with Security, Legal, Privacy, product, engineering, and business leaders to ensure AI retrieves the right information for the right people and processes. This role focuses on data enablement and does not involve model training or development. You will initially be a team of one, hands-on while setting the foundation, and will build and lead a team of data architects and engineers as the company scales.

Responsibilities:

Set the architecture and strategy

• Own the enterprise target-state data architecture for AI enablement, spanning our data stores, integration layers, and a unified access layer across structured and unstructured content

• Set reference architectures for retrieval-based AI: ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, and retrieval APIs

• Establish company-wide standards for connectors, data contracts, APIs, and MCP-style integrations that expose enterprise data to AI tools

• Own a 12-month delivery roadmap and a multi-year data and AI-readiness strategy aligned to business priorities and budget, and secure executive sponsorship for both

Connect structured and unstructured data

• Set the ingestion approach for structured sources (ERP, CRM, finance, HR, operational systems) using batch, change detection, and streaming patterns

• Set the ingestion approach for unstructured and semi-structured sources, including email, documents (PDF, documentation, spreadsheet, slides), wikis and knowledge bases (Notion, Confluence), collaboration tools (Slack, Google Drive), and ticketing systems (JIRA, Github)

• Define  how content is parsed, cleaned, deduplicated, enriched with metadata, and kept fresh through incremental sync, change detection, and deletion handling

• Create and oversee a semantic and metadata layer (taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge graphs where useful) so content from different systems can be connected and searched coherently

Protect what matters

• Be accountable for permission-aware AI retrieval that respects source-system access controls and user entitlements

• Lead data governance in partnership with Security, Privacy and Legal , including cataloging, lineage, metadata, ownership, retention, and quality standards

• Define enterprise policies for sensitive content in AI contexts, such as PII, confidential material, redaction, consent, and legal hold

• Shap

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Egocentric 3D Human Pose)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our core research and development team focused on recovering accurate 3D human body and hand motion from egocentric (first-person) video.
Human demonstration data is the foundation of robot learning, and its quality depends on accurately reconstructing human motion. In this role, you will develop models and production pipelines that transform head-mounted and body-mounted camera streams-including wide-FOV, stereo, motion-blurred, and heavily self-occluded video-into metrically accurate, temporally consistent 3D pose representations for robot policy training and human-to-robot motion retargeting.
You will work across the entire perception stack, including camera calibration, data annotation, model training, evaluation, and large-scale deployment. This role is ideal for engineers with strong expertise in both computer vision and deep learning who enjoy solving challenging real-world perception problems.
Responsibilities

• Develop state-of-the-art 3D body and hand pose estimation models for egocentric video using monocular and stereo camera systems.

• Build models for 2D/3D keypoint estimation, SMPL/SMPL-X, MANO, and full-body motion reconstruction.

• Address challenging egocentric vision problems, including severe self-occlusion, motion blur, rolling shutter artifacts, truncated limbs, extreme viewpoints, and hand-object interaction.

• Design and maintain camera geometry and calibration pipelines, including fisheye and wide-FOV camera models, stereo calibration, triangulation, and coordinate frame alignment.

• Improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility using filtering, kinematic constraints, multi-view fusion, and multi-modal sensor integration.

• Build scalable annotation, evaluation, and quality assurance pipelines for large-scale human motion datasets.

• Optimize large-scale model training and high-throughput inference pipelines for production environments.

• Collaborate closely with robotics engineers to convert reconstructed human motion into high-quality robot training data.

• Contribute to system architecture, engineering best practices, and the long-term evolution of the perception platform.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems.

• Hands-on experience with 3D human pose estimation, hand pose estimation, or human motion tracking from video.

• Strong understanding of multi-view geometry, camera calibration, triangulation, coordinate transformations, and projection models.

• Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with PyTorch or TensorFlow.

• Solid knowledge of modern deep learning techniques, model training, evaluation, and production ML workflows.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with egocentric perception systems, AR/VR headsets, smart glasses, or wearable capture rigs.

• Expertise with SMPL, SMPL-X, MANO, inverse kinematics, markerless motion capture, or hand-object pose estimation.

• Familiarity with egocentric vision datasets and benchmarks.

• Experience with modern video and 3D learning architectures, including Video Transformers, diffusion-based motion models, or 3D CNNs.

• Experience building multi-camera capture systems, synchronization, and calibration infrastructure.

• Experience with human-to-robot motion retargeting, teleoperation, imitation learning, or dexterous manipulation.

• Experience developing annotation tools, active learning pipelines, or large-scale data quality systems.

• Publications at leading conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, SIGGRAPH, or 3DV, open-source contributions, or demonstrated impact in applied AI systems.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and equity package

title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
description: About Cellsor Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that. We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body - living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays - and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring. We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering). About the role As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months. What you will do: Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation Test and iterate with our Boston biology team <

Although the title is Maintenance Manager, this is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports. The successful candidate will personally troubleshoot, repair, inspect, and maintain electrical and mechanical systems throughout the facility. A strong Maintenance Technician or Maintenance Supervisor who is ready to assume full ownership of the maintenance function may be considered. This position works frequently with 480V electrical systems, DC voltage, water pumps, vacuum pumps, furnace elements, fans, hydraulics, and other industrial equipment. The Maintenance Manager will also maintain repair records, manage preventive maintenance activities, monitor MRO inventory, assist with quality and safety initiatives, and support corrective actions. The current maintenance workload is approximately 40% preventive maintenance and 60% emergency or corrective repair. A major objective of this position is to improve the established maintenance program and move the facility toward a more preventive and reliability-focused model.

Electrical issues are currently the most common type of maintenance emergency within the facility. Mechanical Maintenance Troubleshoot and repair mechanical systems and production equipment. Maintain water pumps, vacuum pumps, furnace elements, fans, motors, hydraulic equipment, and related components. Inspect equipment for wear, vibration, leaks, overheating, unusual noise, and other signs of mechanical failure. Evaluate whether equipment should be repaired, rebuilt, or replaced. Reduce repeat failures through root-cause analysis and corrective action. Maintain orderly tools, parts, and maintenance work areas. Vacuum Furnace Maintenance Perform routine and corrective maintenance on vacuum furnaces and related systems. Support the maintenance of vacuum pumps, heating elements, fans, controls, and supporting equipment. Investigate vacuum leaks, heating issues, electrical faults, and equipment-performance concerns. Coordinate furnace downtime and repairs with Operations and Production. Learn facility-specific furnace systems through company-provided on-site training. Maintain accurate records of furnace inspections, repairs, and preventive maintenance activities. Previous vacuum furnace experience is a strong advantage but is not required. The company will provide on-site training to a candidate with strong transferable electrical and mechanical skills. Preventive and Predictive Maintenance Maintain and improve the established preventive maintenance program. Schedule preventive maintenance according to equipment condition, manufacturer recommendations, usage, production priorities, and operational risk. Coordinate maintenance activities with Operations and Quality. Complete inspections, lubrication, adjustments

title: Motor Equipment Mechanic Supervisor
description:
Position Summary The Motor Equipment Mechanic Supervisor is responsible for supervising and participating in the skilled maintenance, diagnosis, inspection, and repair of gasoline- and diesel-powered vehicles and public works equipment. The employee plans assigned repair projects, organizes daily work, supervises mechanics and mechanic helpers, performs journey-level repairs, inspects completed work, and ensures compliance with safety requirements and the New York State Motor Vehicle Inspection Code. The role operates under the general supervision of the Motor Equipment Maintenance Supervisor, with considerable independence in planning and overseeing day-to-day work. The position is assigned to a later or evening shift. Because daytime fleet leadership may not be present during those hours, the successful candidate must be capable of setting priorities, making sound repair decisions, and progressing work independently while maintaining effective communication across shifts. The company may consider a highly experienced senior mechanic who meets the required journey-level experience standard and demonstrates readiness to assume supervisory responsibility.

Annual step and contractual wage increases are available under the CSEA DPW Unit collective bargaining agreement. Benefits The position is eligible for benefits provided under the company's applicable fringe-benefit program and CSEA DPW Unit collective bargaining agreement. Candidates should review the current company materials for complete information regarding healthcare, retirement, leave, holidays, and other benefits.
Schedule and Shift Expectations This position is assigned to an evening or later shift rather than standard daytime operating hours. The exact schedule should be confirmed using the current collective bargaining agreement before the posting is published. Candidates must understand that: The primary fleet manager may not be on-site throughout the shift. The successful candidate must make routine operational and technical decisions independently. Staffing on the evening shift may be limited. The two existing mechanic positions are not necessarily assigned to the same shift. Clear documentation and communication between shifts will be essential. The employee must be comfortable working during nontraditional hours.
Key Responsibilities Shop and Staff Supervision Plan, assign, Client out, and supervise daily maintenance and repair work. Establish repair priorities based on safety, operational need, vehicle availability, and departmental requirements. Supervise Motor Equipment Mechanics, Motor Equipment Mechanic Helpers, and vocational education students. Provide technical direction and hands-on instruction. Review employee work for safety, accuracy, quality, and completeness. Inspect completed repairs before equipment is returned to service. Promote safe work practices and proper use of tools and equipment. Communicate unresolved repairs, parts needs, safety concerns, and operational risks to the Motor Equipment Maintenance Supervisor. Act for the Motor Equipment Maintenance Supervisor when assigned. Gasoline and Diesel Equipment Repair Diagnose, maintain, and repair gasoline- and diesel-powered vehicles and equipment. Perform journey-level mechanical work on engines and engine components. Repair ignition, electrical, and starting systems. Diagnose and repair transmissions, power trains, bearings, axles, and suspension systems. Repair hydraulic systems and components. Inspect and repair brake systems. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance. Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and related equipment failures. Test repaired equipment before returning it to operation.

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Mission: Ecommerce at Fullscript
The ecommerce team is the revenue engine powering Fullscript 's growth.
We own the end-to-end ecommerce experience, including cart, checkout, payments, taxes, discounts, payouts, and financial reporting.
Every transaction, every order, and every dollar flows through what this team builds. We deliver reliability, security, and correctness - while still learning and moving fast
The Role
We’re looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead the ecommerce pod.
This role blends deep technical leadership with people leadership. You are expected to make critical decisions regarding the team’s focus and participate in system design planning. You will stay close to the work while owning systems at the heart of the business and creating the conditions for safe, reliable delivery.
What You'll Do

• Lead a cross-functional Product Engineering pod responsible for payments

• Collaborate across Fullscript ’s engineering org as a technical authority for payments-related decisions

• Own the checkout experience end to end, from cart to confirmation

• Design and maintain integrations with payment processing platforms such as Stripe

• Build and evolve connections to financial systems and fulfillment platforms

• Ensure payment flows are secure, auditable, and highly reliable

• Balance feature delivery with the operational rigor required for revenue-critical systems

How We Expect You to Think

• Treat revenue-critical systems with appropriate care and discipline

• Build for observability and understand what is happening at every step

• Understand the business impact of outages, bugs, and degraded performance

• Know when to move deliberately and when it is safe to move faster

• Own the full lifecycle from design through production operations

What You Bring

• Experience leading ecommerce or transaction-critical systems

• Understanding of payment integrations such as Stripe or similar platforms

• Technical depth and product judgment to guide senior engineering conversations across architecture, system design, reliability, scalability, and technical tradeoffs

• Experience planning and executing platform modernizations, or large refactors in production systems

• Experience directly managing engineers, including coaching, performance management, and career development

• Proven ability to partner closely with finance and operations stakeholders

What We Can Offer You

• Generous PTO and competitive pay

•
Fullscript ’s RRSP match program for financial health

• Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program

• Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives

• Discount on Fullscript catalog of products

• Ability to work Wherever You Work Well*
Our Wherever You Work Well philosophy means Fullscript teammates get to pick their own office - whether that’s in-office, at home, or a bit of both 🐶🏡

title: Surgical Medical Science Liaison, Central
description:
At Alcon , we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

Alcon is looking to hire a Surgical Medical Science Liaison, Central to join our Research & Development function, a team that innovates boldly and delivers new products and services to help revolutionize the eye care industry, advance optimal patient outcomes and help people see brilliantly. The Sr. Principal, Medical Science Liaison (Science/Tech/Engineering Path) is primarily responsible for presenting scientific and clinical information on Alcon products and gathering insights to influence company strategies. You will drive problem-solving and innovation through scientific principles.

This role is remote US with 75% travel and will handle the Surgical portfolio.
Preferred location would be Texas, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana and Missouri
A typical day will include:

• Develop and maintain peer-to-peer relationships with medical experts and key opinion leaders.

• Support the development and adoption of Alcon products through evidence-based scientific exchange and seek external insights.

• Provide general medical information in therapeutic areas to practitioners and Alcon associates and respond to unsolicited requests for medical information.

• Engage in scientific discussions around Alcon product data.

• Implement medical projects and navigate investigator trials from inception to publication.

• Maintain thorough knowledge of Alcon products and current medical/scientific research.

• Work with Med Info and Med Safety to resolve escalated product complaints and medical safety issues, and participate in adverse event reporting and safety responsibilities monitoring.

• Direct human clinical trials, phases III and IV for company products under development, monitor adherence to protocols, and determine study completion.

• Provide reporting information for reports submitted to regulatory agencies.

• Serve as medical consultant to marketing, commercial or research project teams and government regulatory agencies, and act as consultant/liaison with other corporations under licensing agreements.

• Sign off on product safety reviews.

• Interface effectively with all other Medical Affairs functions and departments, including Commercial, Quality Assurance, Research and Development, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, etc.

• Work with integrity and compliance, observing laws, industry standards, and company policies.

• All associates must adhere to GxP regulations by strictly following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintaining accurate and complete documentation, ensuring rigorous quality control, and completing all required training.

• Associates are responsible for meeting their individual job requirements and contributing to the overall compliance of the organization. Compliance with regulatory requirements and a commitment to continuous improvement are essential to our operations​.

What you’ll bring to Alcon :

• Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school+15 yrs; Assoc.+11 yrs; M.S.+4 yrs; PhD+3 yrs)

• The ability to fluently read, write, understand and communicate in English

• 7 Years of Relevant Experience

How You Can Thrive at Alcon :

• See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities

• Join Alcon ’s mission to provide outstanding, innovative products and solutions to improve sight, improve lives, and grow your career!·

•
Alcon provides a robust benefits package including health, life, retirement, flexible time off and much more.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Would you like to join a global, growing company that innovates for a more sustainable tomorrow? UPM could be the team for you. We are frontrunners in developing renewable alternatives to fossil-based materials. Besides enabling both businesses and consumers make more sustainable choices, we strive to create a positive UPM experience for all our employees around the world. We live by our values - trust and be trusted, achieve together, renew with courage. Together we can renew the everyday, for a future beyond fossils!
Learn more about us as a workplace
We are now looking for a Regional Sales Manager to join our team in UPM Graphics . This position is located in the East Region of the United States.

Greetings from your future manager

We’re building something exciting at UPM Graphics, with plenty of room to grow our business, strengthen customer partnerships, and bring new ideas to the graphics market. We believe the best results come from people who take initiative, share ideas, and work together to turn opportunities into results.
As a team, we’re focused on building strong relationships, embracing new challenges, and creating lasting success across the Americas. If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute, grow professionally, and help shape the future of our business, we’d love to have you on the team! - Scott Conrad

What you will do

• Build and nurture strong partnerships with distributors and sales teams, aligning shared goals with UPM Graphics objectives

• Drive product adoption and sustainable growth through collaborative sales calls, targeted prospecting, and tailored solutions for wide-format print providers and related markets

• Deliver comprehensive product training, onboarding, and ongoing support to empower distributors and customers for long-term success

• Monitor performance, use CRM tools for pipeline management and forecasting, and co-create promotions and growth initiatives

• Work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to share insights and implement strategies that unlock market opportunities together

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor’s degree or have equivalent industry experience; an MBA is a plus

• You bring at least five years of experience in sales, account management, or distribution channel management within graphics, signage, or specialty materials

• You have a track record of success in managing distributor relationships and driving regional growth

• You demonstrate strong negotiation and relationship-building skills

• You communicate effectively and deliver engaging presentations

• You are organized and manage time efficiently

• You are proficient in MS Office and CRM platforms (Salesforce or similar)

• You are comfortable with travel, up to 50% within the region

This is what we offer for you

•
A meaningful job: We have an inspiring purpose “We renew the everyday for a future beyond fossils”. Our work is impactful and transformative.

•
A caring community : Our community is built on great team spirit and shared commitment. We care about each other and the well-being of our colleagues. We support the work-life balance of all our employees.

•
Development opportunities : We offer you great opportunities to learn and grow throughout your career. We are an international, multi-business organization offering plenty of avenues for personal growth.

•
Responsible employer : Sustainability is at the core of everything we do. We are committed to ambitious, science-based sustainability targets in all areas, from climate change mitigation to enhancing biodiversity. We foster diversity and inclusivity, offering a work environment in which everyone can be themselves.

Learn about our Rewarding and our Ways of working

Additional information about the position

This is a remote position open only to candidates residing in the continental U.S. due to payroll and compliance requirements.

Travel requirements: up to 50%
